title: Process Advantage Signal Shaping: Advantage Construction for Process-Supervised Reinforcement Learning in LLM Reasoners
abstract: arXiv:2606.29296v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Dense process supervision supplies local feedback but leaves open how that feedback should become a policy advantage. We introduce PASS (Process Advantage Signal Shaping), an advantage-construction pipeline for group-relative policy optimization (GRPO). PASS combines separate reward-channel normalization and fusion, signal-defined chunks for credit accumulation, and normalization by the remaining chunk count. This design connects the scale of local feedback to the resolution and horizon over which it contributes to a policy update. We evaluate PASS using learned process rewards for mathematical reasoning and teacher-derived token signals for multi-hop question answering. On seven mathematics benchmarks, PASS improves average pass@1 by $4.62$ points over outcome-only GRPO while reducing average response length by approximately $2\%$. translated_title: 过程优势信号塑形：面向大语言模型推理器中过程监督强化学习的优势构造
translated_abstract: 密集的过程监督能够提供局部反馈，但这种反馈应如何转化为策略优势仍是一个悬而未决的问题。我们提出了PASS（过程优势信号塑形），这是一个面向组相对策略优化（GRPO）的优势构造流水线。PASS结合了独立的奖励通道归一化与融合、用于信用积累的信号定义分块，以及按剩余分块数量进行的归一化。这一设计将局部反馈的尺度与其对策略更新产生贡献的分辨率和范围联系起来。我们使用学习到的过程奖励在数学推理任务上评估PASS，并使用教师派生的token信号在多跳问答任务上进行评估。在七个数学基准上，PASS相比仅使用结果奖励的GRPO，平均pass@1提升了4.62个百分点，同时将平均响应长度减少了约2%。在采用均值中心化归一化的多跳问答任务上，PASS分别超过仅结果训练0.87和0.
tldr: 提出PASS优势构造流水线，通过奖励通道归一化融合、信号定义分块和剩余分块数归一化，将密集过程反馈有效转化为策略优势，在七个数学基准上比仅结果奖励的GRPO平均pass@1提升4.62点，同时响应长度缩短约2%。
en_tdlr: PASS is an advantage-construction pipeline for GRPO that shapes dense process feedback into policy advantages via separate reward-channel normalization and fusion, signal-defined chunking, and normalization by remaining chunk count, improving average pass@1 by 4.62 points over outcome-only GRPO on seven math benchmarks while reducing response length by about 2%.
